messages.x.connection.auth-help: Do not paste an App-Only Bearer from the developer dashboard: /users/me returns 403. Use an OAuth 2.0 User Access Token (PKCE) or another user-context token with tweet.read and users.read. The public API charges by plan and your developer account needs the appropriate API access.
messages.x.guide.oauth-note: User context and tweet.read and users.read permissions are required. Molis Work does not yet handle the callback.
messages.x.guide.token-note: Use an OAuth user access token. An app-only bearer token cannot access the current identity endpoint.
